column1: # The package set, and the single source of truth for it.
# build/BuildNugets.sh packs in this order, the release and pull-request workflows generate their
# package tables from it, and tests/OpenTok.Net.PackageTests reads it. Adding a package means adding
# a row here and a project under src/ - nothing else keeps a second copy of the list.
# One row, deliberately: this repository is a façade. OpenTok.Net.iOS and OpenTok.Net.Android - the
# packages that actually bind OpenTok.xcframework and opentok-android-sdk.aar - are built and
# published from their own repositories and consumed here as ordinary pinned NuGet dependencies (see
# OpenTokNetiOSVersion/OpenTokNetAndroidVersion in Directory.Build.props), not packed by this script.
#   id      the NuGet package id, which is also the directory under src/ and the .csproj name
#   heads   which target-framework family the package ships:
#             mobile - both android and ios heads
#   deps    other ids in this repository it depends on, comma separated, or -
